name: Subete Ubatte Yaru!
source:
Ryuya's life has changed completely after Atsuko, his mother, got remarried. Tatsuo, his new father, robs him of his position in his family. Konoha, his younger sister, also depends on Tatsuo. He dislikes Serina, his new older sister, too. One night, Ryuya sees Atsuko and Tatsuo having sex and his anger reaches its peak. Several days later, Tatsuo leaves his home for ten days on business. Ryuya makes up his mind that he will get back what used to be while Tatsuo is out....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
母親敦子再婚後，龍也的生活徹底改變了。他的繼父辰雄剝奪了他在家庭中的地位。妹妹木葉也很依賴辰雄。他也不喜歡他的繼姊瑟琳娜。一天晚上，龍也看到敦子和辰雄做愛，他的憤怒達到了頂峰。幾天後，辰雄因公出差離開家十天。龍也下定決心，趁辰雄不在的時候，一定要把原本屬於自己的生活奪回來……
